about.title: About Digital Academy
about.subtitle: A platform designed by and for students of digital tracks.
about.missionText: Centralize the learning resources of the Digital Development and Digital Infrastructure tracks so that every student can quickly find the right document: courses, labs, corrected exercises, exams and projects.
about.visionText: Become the reference for IT students in Morocco, with a simple, fast and organized platform, accessible on all devices.
about.value1Text: Teachers and students contribute to the community's resources.
about.value2Text: Every document is organized, classified and verified before publication.
about.value3Text: A fast, responsive platform available everywhere, on desktop and mobile.
about.teamText: Digital Academy is an independent educational project, open to OFPPT students and all IT learners.
